Name: Potioneer's Kitchen(CP)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
1.1.0版本更新：同时对姜岛厨房进行美化。
Version 1.1.0 Update: Now also changes the textures of the Ginger Island kitchen.

=======================================================

将农舍厨房纹理更换为魔药学风格样式，一共有四种色调。

这个Mod需要CP（Content Patcher）及GMCM（Generic Mod Config Menu）作为前置，在GMCM设置菜单中更改厨房色调。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅


Reskins the farmhouse kitchen into a potioneer's kitchen style, and features four color variants.
This mod requires CP (Content Patcher) and GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu).Use the GMCM configuration menu to change the kitchen's color scheme.
